item.title: BMW Industries Q2 Results: Net profit rise 43% YoY to Rs 21.62 crore
item.description: BMW Industries Ltd has reported an impressive 42.7 percent increase in net profit for the quarter ending on September 30. The firm's total income surged by 33 percent compared to the same quarter last fiscal year, while EBITDA rose by 25 percent, showcasing its resilience and growth. Notably, the new greenfield downstream steel complex in Bokaro commenced operations, with future plans focused on optimizing capacity utilization across these facilities.

item.title: HCC Q2 profit slumps 53% to Rs 22 crore
item.description: Hindustan Construction Company reported a decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Income and expenses also saw a reduction in comparison to the previous year's figures. The company secured an order of Rs 524 crore and participated in several project bids. Additionally, construction progressed on various projects including the Indore and Patna Metro.

item.title: India’s new wealth rituals: What are millennials and Gen Z buying on Dhanteras?
item.description: Dhanteras investing is evolving from physical gold purchases toward diversified digital portfolios. Younger investors are embracing gold ETFs, mutual funds, Bitcoin and tokenised assets while retaining the festival’s core goal of building wealth and financial security patiently.

item.title: Beyond gold: What $340 billion in crypto flows says about India's investment preferences this Dhanteras
item.description: Gold remains central to Indian household savings, but high prices are pushing investors toward ETFs and digital gold instead of physical holdings. Crypto is emerging as a separate portfolio option rather than replacing gold, reflecting a broader shift toward digital ownership and diversification.

item.title: Largecap dhamaka! 6 bluechip stocks with upside of up to 48% to buy this Diwali
item.description: As Samvat 2083 approaches, careful stock selection is vital due to global uncertainties. Religare Broking identifies six largecap stocks, such as Bajaj Finance and Mahindra Mahindra, that show promising upside this Diwali. With each stock displaying unique growth characteristics supporting their projected price targets, analysts stress the importance of sustainable earnings growth. A diversified portfolio is essential for effectively navigating the changing market dynamics.
